description: The order a product's banked missions are taken in, at @worktrees/banked/<product>/queue.json. The queue is `entries`, in order: the array position is the order and there is no second list of ids to drift from it (scripts/bank.mjs#reorder rewrites the array). An entry names one mission of the same bank, what has become of it (banked, running under a session, done under a session, or dropped), what it waits for and how urgent it is; `next` is the first entry that is `banked`, whose every dependsOn is `done`, while no sibling of the same product is `running` — one mission per product at a time, and a mission that stopped for the person pauses the bank because its entry stays `running`. The queue hash the approval records is taken over this file's canonical form (scripts/bank.mjs#queueHash), so adding, reordering or dropping an entry invalidates the approval and the person is asked once more.

bankedBy.description: the helper run that last drafted this queue; every bank names the run that drafted it (@worktrees/helpers/<id>/runs/<runId>/)

status.description: banked, dropped, or running:<sessionId> / done:<sessionId> — a mission that ran names the session that ran it, so the bank and the session ledger point at each other

dependsOn.description: missions of this bank that must be done before this one is taken; each is an entry of this file
